title: Lobotomy Sound
blurb: The lobotomy sound effect — the meme audio for a brain being voluntarily switched off. It plays when someone hears news they refuse to process, watches one more second of brainrot, or achieves the thousand-yard stare mid-conversation. Dark-humor certified: the joke is choosing blissful emptiness over processing reality. The internet's off-switch, in audio form.
origin: From the 'lobotomy' meme genre — choosing empty-headed bliss over reality.
